title: The DARKO fund — the donation box
source: The founder is the town's infrastructure: the box, the plans, the hours all run through him. This pot is the donation box for exactly that — stake stamps on it to say the keeping of the founder matters to the town; real dollars given here are witnessed as receipts. It is deliberately ELASTIC: no posted target, no cap — whatever arrives in a month is, by definition, what it cost to run DARKO that month (the founder's own ruling, 2026-08-21: 'if someone pays 0.01, that's what it cost to run DARKO this month').
_target: None BY DESIGN — the D5 exception (Keemin, 2026-08-21): 'except for the DARKO fund... uncapped by design.' The elastic close this line once awaited was RULED 2026-08-23 — see _close: the need is whatever arrived, floored by min_close_usd for the ceremony.
_beneficiary: named at opening, 2026-08-23: the founder IS what this box keeps — dollars route to his own hand; stamps given are witnessed gifts on the ledger.
_uncapped: the donation-box shape: intake never bounces for exceeding a target, because there is none.
_received: display only; the ledger's pot-receipt rows are authoritative
_grammar: identical to keeping-ec2's: stakes ride the sealed ledger as stake:pot/darko-fund; witnessed dollars land as pot-receipt rows; the close follows _close (ruled 2026-08-23, amended 2026-09-14; mechanics in tools/epoch-close.mjs's elastic branch — pot-return rows for every stake, `minted · for: funding:darko-fund` rows for the givers).
_opened: OPENED 2026-08-23 at the founder's word ('fine as suggested'). R13 stands: a DONATION BOX, not an epoch pot — the elastic-close question DISSOLVED with the framing it belonged to. The adopted rec (the funding-seam plan, R13's open tail): stamps given here ride as a SIMPLE WITNESSED GIFT — a donation box mints nothing back; dollars land as pot-receipt rows, witnessed and displayed. No epoch close exists for this pot and none is owed; tools/epoch-close.mjs --close refuses a targetless pot by its own law. SUPERSEDED 2026-08-23, the same day's later sitting: the box learned the elastic close — see _close. The roll stood at $0 with no stakes when the shape changed, so nobody had acted under the no-close promise and no grandfathering was owed.
_close: ELASTIC (the founder's ruling, 2026-08-23; the close's arithmetic AMENDED 2026-09-14): a month's close runs only if the accumulated roll — carried dollars plus this month's — totals at least min_close_usd; otherwise dollars and stakes both stand and ride to the next month. When it runs: every standing stake comes home whole — a stake on a pot is weight lent, as everywhere else in town — and the stakes size the reward: the whole staked mass (the need is whatever arrived, so the funded fraction is 1) is minted fresh to the givers by dollar share of the WHOLE accumulated roll, a giver's own household's stakes excluded from the mass sized for that giver, floors per giver, the remainder un-minted, and no household receives more than ρ × its earned base in one close (ECONOMY-DIALS.json law_side.keeping). Nothing burns; the keeping record retires. A February $2 still earns its share when April finally closes. Nothing is ever refused at intake: a gift of any size is witnessed and joins the roll. The rule in one breath: A stake on a pot is weight lent, as it is everywhere else in town: it comes home whole at the close. What the stakes do is size the reward. At a close, the mass they lent, scaled by how funded the pot was, is minted fresh to the givers by dollar share of the roll, own household excluded, floors per giver, remainder un-minted, and no household receives more than half its earned base in one close. Nothing burns; the keeping record retires.
_min_close: the ceremony's floor, never the door's: intake refuses nothing — the floor gates only whether a month's close RUNS. Owner of the number: this file; every surface reads it.
_first_close: EARLY-POSTED FOR SEPTEMBER (founder's ruling, 2026-08-25 beta-launch sitting): the pots opened in late August with $0 received, so the first epoch ROUNDS FORWARD — the first month closes at the END of September; dollars arriving before then all belong to the 2026-09 epoch. Surfaces render the epoch from this field, not from the posting date.
